prompts:
Create SIX new PLAIN GREY ROCK sprites matching the simplified flat-faceted art style of the supplied reference sheet. Reference is only for style. Output EXACTLY2columns x3rows on transparent background, no other objects, no text, no labels or grid. Each cell24x24 logical pixels, output can be enlarged. Column1 SMALL low stone(14x9pixel footprint), column2 LARGE tall boulder(19x19). Each row is a matched small/large pair with a NEW silhouette DIFFERENT from the reference's generic rounded angular rock.

ROW1: FLAT SLAB shape: broad horizontal top, straight chopped edge, trapezoid low stone; large version is a thick upright blocky slab with an angled shoulder, broad flat top and a single dark side.
ROW2: WEDGE shape: asymmetric slanted triangular rock with one steep side and one long sloping planar top; large version is a tall angular leaning wedge, clearly different silhouette from slab.
ROW3: SPLIT NOTCH shape: low two-lobed angular stone with a single clean dark notch cut in its top edge; large version is a substantial blocky boulder with one stepped notch and two simple planes, still one connected mass.

ALL SIX are plain neutral GRAYSCALE rock: zero ore, zero gems, zero flint, zero colored flecks, zero moss or lava or vegetation. Only four or five flat shades of neutral grey, black/dark charcoal stepped pixel outline, light grey top, middle grey front, deep grey side. NO tiny surface details, no mottling, texture, dither, gradients or extra fissures. Broad geometric faceted map-tile shapes, low visual complexity, simple like classic16px RPG rocks. Upper-left light, overhead tilted45degrees toward south camera, not isometric. Full object within its assigned cell with at least2px margin, centered horizontally ground contact at22px. Clear transparent gaps, no background or ground patch.
